title: Storm Sorceress and Dragon
description: A sorceress with long flowing blue hair stands on a swirling vortex of water in the center of a stormy sea, holding a glowing green staff. Above her, a large multicolored dragon with red, green, and blue scales breathes orange fire while flying through a dramatic sky filled with lightning, swirling clouds, and a massive vortex.
prompt: A powerful sorceress with long flowing blue hair wearing blue and gold armor stands atop a swirling blue water vortex in the middle of a turbulent stormy sea. She holds a tall glowing green staff. A massive multicolored dragon with red, green, and blue scales flies above her, breathing bright orange fire from its open mouth. The dramatic sky is filled with purple and green storm clouds, lightning strikes, and a giant swirling vortex. Below are multiple wooden sailing ships being tossed in the rough waves. Dark birds fly in the distance.
